if the code is invalid, and at the end
if there were no sales. In a tie of units, the product with the lowest code wins.

hints.text: Go back to your card: which boxes do you need to remember what happened all day?
It is the dictated money box of
Three parallel arrays: names, prices and units sold. The code minus 1 is the index.
Read the code; while it is not 0, read the amount, check, write the line and add; at the end, the total, the discount and the search for the best seller. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Add to the closing how many valid sales there were and the average price per sale.

Hidden cases: an invalid code in the middle, a tie (cookie and juice with 2 units: juice wins, with the lowest code), a single sale, the five products, large amounts and a day whose only sale is invalid. Frequent mistake: searching for the best seller with
, which in a tie picks the one with the highest code.
